protocol.name: bead_layer_motion_v1

description.summary: Compositor-driven layer surface presentation

protocol.description: Defines a set of rectangular presentation planes sampling one layer surface buffer. A compositor animates the planes at output presentation rate without requiring client commits for each animation frame.

description.summary: Create presentation controllers for layer surfaces

entry.name: duplicate_controller
entry.summary: Surface already has a motion controller

request.name: get_motion

description.summary: Create a controller for a layer surface

request.description: The surface must already have a layer-shell role. The client should create the controller and its planes in the same commit that attaches the first complete buffer.

interface.name: bead_layer_motion_v1

description.summary: Group animation of atlas presentation planes

interface.description: Plane requests are double-buffered with the associated wl_surface state. The animate request starts one shared timeline for all configured planes on the next predicted presentation following the commit. Source rectangles use the logical surface texture after buffer transform and viewport mapping. Destination rectangles and clips use logical surface-local units. Clips are fixed in the unanimated surface frame and applied after the destination rectangle is placed. Planes are composited in creation order: the first plane is backmost and each later plane appears above earlier ones. Version 2 adds a compound reveal contour. Geometry and radii share the plane animation timeline; contour rectangles are unioned, then holes are removed with the even-odd rule. Rect arrays contain at most 16 entries, each encoded as four signed 24.8 wl_fixed values (x, y, width, height) in native connection byte order. Their byte lengths must be multiples of 16. All geometry and gradient coordinates are root-local logical units.

description.summary: Normalized easing function applied to all planes
Opacity interpolation function

entry.name: opaque_above
entry.summary: Use full opacity above the configured threshold

entry.name: visible
entry.summary: Draw and apply the contour as a mask

entry.name: tracking_only
entry.summary: Track geometry without drawing or masking

description.summary: Destroy controller and cancel any active animation

request.name: add_plane

description.summary: Add a source rectangle and initial presentation state

request.description: The source is immutable for the plane lifetime. All coordinates and extents are logical fixed-point values. Extents must be non-negative.

description.summary: Set the target presentation state of one plane
Set the starting state used by the next animation

request.name: animate

description.summary: Start one synchronized animation for all planes

request.description: Requests take effect atomically on the next wl_surface.commit. A nonzero retarget samples every plane's current presentation and ignores the from states supplied with add_plane. A zero retarget uses those from states. Replacing an active animation cancels its serial first.

description.summary: Freeze the active animation at its current state

request.name: reset

description.summary: Clear compositor presentation state at the next surface commit

request.description: The compositor samples and cancels any active animation, then removes all configured planes and presentation transforms for the associated surface. Pending plane, animation, or cancel requests queued before reset are discarded. The reset becomes visible atomically with the next wl_surface.commit, which may attach ordinary replacement content. Cancellation events for the active serial are sent after that commit. The staged curve returns to linear; requests queued after reset may define a new plane set for the same commit. The controller remains usable, and serial monotonicity is preserved.

request.name: set_reveal_bounds

description.summary: Set root-local output and crop bounds for reveal rendering

request.description: Coordinates and extents outside the inclusive logical range -32768 to 32768 are invalid and must be rejected by the client before sending. Output and crop bounds may be disabled with both extents zero; otherwise both width and height must be positive.

request.name: set_reveal_geometry

description.summary: Set compound animated reveal geometry

request.description: Fixed rectangles and the animated rounded rectangle are unioned; holes are removed with even-odd fill. Endpoints and radii interpolate on the shared curve. square_edges bits are left=1, top=2, right=4, bottom=8. RGBA is unpremultiplied sRGB packed as 0xRRGGBBAA. Fill, rim, and shadow alpha follow the sampled opacity of opacity_plane. Clients must not pair a shadow with static rectangles, holes, or the quadratic-cut corner mode; that combination is unsupported.

request.name: set_reveal_content_clip

description.summary: Set animated content clip endpoints

request.description: This clip preserves layer-surface reveal-window semantics separately from the rounded contour mask. Both rectangles interpolate on the shared animation curve and are intersected with crop and surface bounds.

request.name: set_reveal_rects

description.summary: Set fixed contour rectangles and even-odd holes

request.description: Each array contains at most 16 x/y/width/height tuples, each encoded as four native-endian signed 24.8 wl_fixed integers (16 bytes). Length must be a multiple of 16 before any element is decoded. Every rectangle and hole must have positive width and height; zero-area entries are invalid.

request.name: set_reveal_rim

description.summary: Set a constant three-stop compositor-rendered rim gradient

request.description: Colors are unpremultiplied sRGB packed 0xRRGGBBAA. Stops are normalized gradient positions. Geometry is in root-local logical units. A visible rim with nonzero width and opacity requires distinct start and end points; zero-width or zero-opacity rims may use a degenerate vector.

request.name: set_reveal_shadow

description.summary: Set optional compositor-rendered reveal shadow

request.description: RGBA is unpremultiplied sRGB packed as 0xRRGGBBAA. Blur, spread and offsets use root-local logical surface units. The shadow follows the contour's sampled per-corner radii throughout the timeline. Clients may send it only for a circular animated rounded rectangle with no static rectangles or holes.

request.name: set_reveal_mode

description.summary: Select visible contour rendering or invisible geometry tracking

request.description: Tracking-only mode preserves animated geometry and radii for retargeting, and tracks content-clip endpoints, but draws no contour, applies no contour mask or content clip, and imposes no hit-test restriction. Whole-scene close atlases continue to use ordinary plane clipping.

event.name: plane_state

description.summary: Final committed state of one plane

event.description: Sent once for every plane before done or cancelled.
